meaning: Madhav's own trades, in his words, so Ananta can learn how he reads the market. Prices are what he paid on NDAX (CAD). The rebuild (src/research/casebook.py) pins each buy to the candles and checks every reason against the data, point in time.

his_reasons: Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana were low and collapsing
Bought at the lowest as I saw it, after comparing support areas and resistance zones and how strong they are
The market had been bad for quite some time; the bear felt like it was weakening
The coin itself is valuable, so a flexible stop loss to hold through noise
cases.context_he_gave: Ethereum was about 2150 CAD at the time

his_reasons: Same read as C1: low after a long fall, at support he trusted, bear weakening, no fresh bad news, near the 52-week low
